finishing: OpenVAS is finishing its last checks (its slowest part). It stops by {{time}} at the latest and keeps what it found.
limitReached: OpenVAS reached its time limit and is collecting what it found.
leftSoon: less than a minute left in this step
longer: taking longer than estimated, still working
quietHelp: The scanner reports at most every 5 seconds, and some checks report nothing until they finish. A quiet scanner is still working; Stop ends it at any time.
